description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThrottlingConfig' that provides configuration settings related to throttling, such as interval and limit, for the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes default method implementations, static factory methods, and an internal enum for config keys and defaults.

classes.name: ThrottlingConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration for throttling, including methods to get interval and limit, render config, and create instances from a Config.

classes.name: ThrottlingConfig.ConfigValue
classes.description: An enum defining configuration keys and default values for the 'ThrottlingConfig', implementing 'KnownConfigValue'.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration of the throttling interval.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit on the number of messages processed within the interval.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Converts this config into a Config object representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ThrottlingConfig instance from a given Config object.
